key_insight: OuroWorld turns a static 3D scene into a lively, endlessly looping 3D cinemagraph that looks dynamic from any viewpoint. It combines AI-generated motion with multi-view consistency so the scene stays coherent while continuously animating.
problem_solved: Most photorealistic 3D world models are visually impressive but frozen in time. This paper addresses how to add realistic, view-consistent motion to any existing 3D Gaussian Splatting scene without requiring manual masks or scene-specific animation setup.
method: Use a vision-language model to infer plausible scene dynamics from the static 3D content and text cues.
Guide a video generation model to synthesize a reference dynamic video with looping motion.
Lift the reference video into multi-view supervision and complete missing views for 3D consistency.
Train with imperfect supervision using a robust learning strategy so motion stays vivid, diverse, and seamless from any camera angle.
impact: For practitioners, this offers a practical way to animate existing 3D scenes without rebuilding them from scratch. It can improve interactive media, virtual environments, and content creation workflows by adding realistic looping motion with minimal manual effort.

paper_title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
